## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD6: Cutover window + rollback procedure documented.

## Implementation Notes
Update plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md with section '## Sub-PR cutover migration runbook'. Document:
- Invocation order: (1) migrate-ledger-v11-to-v12.sh; (2) update-required-checks-manifest.sh; (3) promote-ruleset-required.sh --stage-as-non-required; (4) observation window (1 week); (5) promote-ruleset-required.sh --promote-to-required; (6) exempt-in-flight-prs.sh.
- Idempotency guarantees per script.
- Rollback: invoke rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh; what it does + does NOT (e.g., no workflow restore unless --restore-workflows).
- Pre-cutover tagging: 'git tag pre-cutover-sub-pr' before step 1.
- Cross-links to S1, S2, S4.

Doc-router Gate 2.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Doc contains cutover runbook section
  Verify: grep -qE 'cutover.*runbook|Sub-PR.*cutover' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] Covers all 5 scripts
  Verify: grep -cE 'migrate-ledger|update-required-checks|promote-ruleset|exempt-in-flight|rollback-sub-pr' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md | awk '{exit ($1>=4?0:1)}'
data.title: S_mig.T10: Document cutover runbook + rollback procedure in CI-INTEGRATION.md
